briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Regulators Crack Down at Home as Washington's Drug Policy Shuffles
briefs.top: Michigan's Cannabis Regulatory Agency and Attorney General delivered back-to-back enforcement blows this week — revoking Muha Meds' Ypsilanti license over illegal bulk sales and winning a court ruling against Bliss Cannabis for destroying protected wetlands — while both parties' gubernatorial hopefuls now court the industry on the 24% wholesale tax. Nationally, Curaleaf keeps pressing its hostile Aurora takeover, the Senate confirmed Trump's cannabis-friendly drug czar pick, and the DEA's psilocybin review and a GOP push on Chinese-linked grow operations both move forward.
